## Installation

The SDK is distributed from GitHub release tags.

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/Statflo/statflo-python-sdk.git@dev_20261120155335"
```

or add it to your `requirements.txt`:

```text
statflo-python-sdk @ git+https://github.com/Statflo/statflo-python-sdk.git@dev_20261120155335
```

or to your `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
dependencies = [
  "statflo-python-sdk @ git+https://github.com/Statflo/statflo-python-sdk.git@dev_20261120155335",
]
```

Then import the package:

```python
import statflo_python_sdk
```

## Getting Started

Please follow the [installation](#installation) instruction and execute the following Python code:

```python
import os

from statflo_python_sdk import ApiClient, Configuration, CampaignApi
from statflo_python_sdk.models import CampaignPaginationResponse


def campaign_example() -> None:
    configuration = Configuration(
        host=os.environ["STATFLO_HOST"],
        access_token=os.environ["STATFLO_ACCESS_TOKEN"],
    )

    with ApiClient(configuration) as api_client:
        campaign_api = CampaignApi(api_client)

        response: CampaignPaginationResponse = campaign_api.campaign_search(
            filter={},
            query="",
            page=1,
            per_page=10,
            sort="",
        )
        for campaign in response.items or []:
            print(campaign)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    campaign_example()
```
